predicates.active_identity_clean: active/public allowlist surfaces contain no unapproved legacy authority token or local absolute source path
predicates.registry_consistent: session_registry reconcile --check and validate both return zero
predicates.kb_deterministic: all renderable canonical KB JSON has a matching Markdown projection and render_kb --check returns zero
predicates.references_resolve: all in-scope active and SP-001 evidence links resolve or carry an explicit non-deceptive tombstone locator
predicates.doctor_nonempty: standard doctor executes a nonzero inventory of tests and all required gates pass
predicates.final_evidence_complete: OPCM, Validation, Semantic Review, closeout and post-closeout cover MH-01..MH-15 and final diff

invariants: Dashboard remains execution memory and never replaces kb/data canonical truth
source Markdown is never promoted without canonical JSON adjudication
historical provenance may retain legacy tokens but cannot become active authority or public payload
test pass, independent validation, human approval, Git state, public release and production readiness remain separate axes
SP-001 done requires all completion predicates; no single gate or historical Done row is sufficient
forbidden_collapses: historical Session Done = current SP-001 complete
claim_ceiling: repo-local SP-001 quality recovery complete under the frozen predicates; no public release, universal portability or production claim
